movies.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
movies.tagline: One summer to feel everything.
movies.title: The Last Sunrise

movies.overview: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.
movies.title: Vishwanath & Sons

movies.overview: When an American heir living in a luxurious Spanish villa decides to move in with his girlfriend, his departure triggers a family collapse as his brother uncovers the truth behind their mother's tragic death.
movies.tagline: People are roses. Families are rosebushes. Rosebushes need pruning.
movies.title: Rosebush Pruning

movies.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.
movies.tagline: If you leave a door half open, soon you'll hear the whispers spoken.
movies.title: The Whisper Man

movies.overview: In 140 AD, twenty years after the unexplained disappearance of the entire Ninth Legion in the mountains of Scotland, young centurion Marcus Aquila arrives from Rome to solve the mystery and restore the reputation of his father, the commander of the Ninth. Accompanied only by his British slave Esca, Marcus sets out across Hadrian's Wall into the uncharted highlands of Caledonia - to confront its savage tribes, make peace with his father's memory, and retrieve the lost legion's golden emblem, the Eagle of the Ninth.
movies.tagline: The destiny of a soldier. The honour of a slave. The fate of an empire.
movies.title: The Eagle

movies.overview: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.
movies.tagline: The legend ends.
movies.title: The Dark Knight Rises

movies.overview: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

production_companies.name: iQIYI Pictures （重复 同 iQiyi Motion Pictures）

movies.tagline: He's training a new generation of law enforcers for a dangerous mission to save the world from ruthless criminals.
movies.title: The Shadow's Edge

movies.overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
movies.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption

movies.overview: A gentle artist contends with his cheating girlfriend, and an innocent girl longs to break free from an abusive relationship. When fate brings these two lovelorn people together, true love finally blossoms.
movies.tagline: Love is baring body and soul
movies.title: Desnudos

movies.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.
movies.tagline: He was no hero.
movies.title: The Death of Robin Hood

movies.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
movies.tagline: An offer you can't refuse.
movies.title: The Godfather

movies.overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.
movies.tagline: Discover the making of a king.
movies.title: Michael

movies.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.
movies.tagline: Icons reign forever.
movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2

movies.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.
movies.title: Call My Agent! The Movie

movies.original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
movies.overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"
movies.tagline: Ring any bells?
movies.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?

movies.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
movies.title: Interstellar

movies.overview: Two VMX queens, Aliya Raymundo and Margaret Diaz, play reunited childhood friends who share a memorable past and a complicated present: one is a liberated city girl, the other a sheltered country virgin, and both are surrounded by men eager to get a taste of their youth.
movies.title: Hibla 2

movies.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.
movies.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups

movies.overview: A sexual reverie unfolds over the course of one ethereal night. Characters wander through an erotic maze of love and lust, blurring the lines between wet dream and lucid nightmare as a macabre, erotic stage performance sends a ripple of lustful desires through its audience and performers.
movies.title: Islands

movies.overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.
movies.title: Gandhari

movies.overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.
movies.tagline: Hey Frank.
movies.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill

movies.overview: A veteran inmate takes a newcomer under his wing as the pair confront both other violent inmates and the prison's corrupt wardens.
movies.title: Prison on Fire

movies.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.
movies.tagline: The world forever changes.
movies.title: Oppenheimer

movies.overview: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.
movies.tagline: The truth behind a perfect marriage.
movies.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman

movies.overview: Have a taste of VMX Newest Temptation Apphle Celso. Lena, a Kesong Puti vendor, meets a charming dairy supplier Manny. Their chemistry sparks a daring secret that transforms her humble cheese into their town’s obsession.
movies.title: Kesong Puti

movies.overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.
movies.tagline: Act like you own the place.
movies.title: Parasite

movies.overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.
movies.title: The Secret Woman

movies.overview: A US Army officer, who made a "friendly fire" mistake that was covered up, has been reassigned to a desk job. He is tasked to investigate a female chopper commander's worthiness to be awarded the Medal of Honor. At first all seems in order. But then he begins to notice inconsistencies between the testimonies of the witnesses...
movies.tagline: A medal for honor. A search for justice. A battle for truth.
movies.title: Courage Under Fire

movies.overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.
movies.tagline: El Asesino Que Dividió A Un País
movies.title: Barreda

movies.overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, Jack Dawson and Fabrizio De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. Rose tells the whole story from Titanic's departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.
movies.tagline: Nothing on earth could come between them.
movies.title: Titanic

movies.overview: Kamila has everything under control: studies, social life, her image... Everything except the unexpected return of her neighbors, the Di Bianco brothers, after seven years of absence. Thiago stole her first kiss, and Taylor was her best friend, but now their return will turn Kami's world upside down. Can the three overcome the past that binds them? Or will everything explode into pieces once again?
movies.title: Tell Me Softly

belongs_to_collection.name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: The Movie Collection

movies.original_title: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ〈ワルプルギスの廻天〉
movies.overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.
movies.tagline: The world will not exonerate her.
movies.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-

movies.overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.
movies.tagline: Paul Edgecomb didn't believe in miracles. Until the day he met one.
movies.title: The Green Mile

movies.overview: Young lion prince Simba, eager to one day become king of the Pride Lands, grows up under the watchful eye of his father Mufasa; all the while his villainous uncle Scar conspires to take the throne for himself. Amid betrayal and tragedy, Simba must confront his past and find his rightful place in the Circle of Life.
movies.tagline: The greatest adventure of all is finding our place in the Circle of Life.
movies.title: The Lion King

movies.overview: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed out of retirement to lead a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentor a young hotshot driver—while chasing one more chance at glory.
movies.tagline: Let's ride.
movies.title: F1

movies.overview: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.
movies.tagline: Jinke kaam mein seva, jinke bhav mein bhakti, aur jinke hriday mein Sita Ram.
movies.title: Hanuman Ansh

movies.overview: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred. Eventually, Maximus is forced to become a gladiator and battle to the death against other men for the amusement of paying audiences.
movies.tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.
movies.title: Gladiator

movies.overview: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of TOP GUN graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.
movies.tagline: Feel the need... The need for speed.
movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick

movies.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.
movies.tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.
movies.title: Forrest Gump

movies.overview: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.
movies.tagline: Witness the wedding of the year.
movies.title: The Drama

movies.overview: An Italian-American woman traveling to Sicily picks up a teenager who claims to be in trouble with some drug dealers.
movies.title: Woman in the Moon

movies.overview: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.
movies.tagline: Meet the little voices inside your head.
movies.title: Inside Out

movies.overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.
movies.tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.
movies.title: Fight Club

movies.overview: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.
movies.tagline: Feared by the British... forgotten by his countrymen.
movies.title: G.D.N

movies.overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
movies.tagline: Life, liberty, and the pursuit of vengeance.
movies.title: Django Unchained

movies.overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?
movies.tagline: It'll be fun.
movies.title: The Invite

movies.overview: Set during the summer of 1957. Ex-racecar driver, Enzo Ferrari, is in crisis. Bankruptcy stalks the company he and his wife, Laura, built from nothing ten years earlier. Their tempestuous marriage struggles with the mourning for one son and the acknowledgement of another.
movies.title: Ferrari

movies.overview: After unintentionally causing the death of his opponent during a martial arts tournament, Hatta vows to never participate in any fighting tournament again. However, when his only sister becomes seriously ill and requires costly medical treatment, he is offered 'financial assistance' by a head of mobsters in return for Hatta fighting for him in the underworld fighting ring.
movies.tagline: You're just a cock.
movies.title: Tarung: Unforgiven

movies.overview: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.
movies.tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi occupied France...
movies.title: Inglourious Basterds

movies.overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.
movies.tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
